source_name: zmluvy.gov.sk — legacy/mirror listing of CRZ by institution
why_relevant: Institution-indexed view of the central register (per-ministry / per-public-body contract lists, e.g. Slovenská pošta a.s.). Useful when you want the complete contract set of one obliged entity (e.g. Štátna pokladnica, Slovenská pošta, Sociálna poisťovňa) rather than a keyword slice, and as a cross-check against crz.gov.sk indexing gaps.

source_name: eGovZmluvy — zmluvy.egov.sk (verejný register odberateľských vzťahov)
why_relevant: Commercial publishing platform used by a large number of Slovak municipalities, cities, budgetary/contributory organisations and schools to meet the Act 546/2010 duty for zmluvy, objednávky and faktúry. Since 1.4.2022 it auto-forwards to CRZ, but it retains its own searchable per-entity register with invoices and orders — the layer that reveals recurring cash-handling, ATM, card-acceptance and bank-fee spend at sub-national level that CRZ contract metadata alone does not show.

source_name: OtvorenéZmluvy.sk / Transparency International Slovensko contract analytics
why_relevant: TIS + Aliancia Fair-play project that re-processes CRZ plus smaller registers covering roughly 130 additional entities (mostly municipalities and schools). Valuable as a pointer to registers outside CRZ, to methodology for cleaning contract data, and to red-flag heuristics (direct awards, price outliers) applicable to banking/payment contracts.

source_name: Slovensko.Digital Ekosystém / Datahub — CRZ + RPO + RÚZ linked API
why_relevant: Cleaned, consolidated and cross-linked copies of state registers including the central register of contracts, register of legal entities (RPO/RPO v2), commercial register and register of financial statements, exposed via API and SQL. Lets you join a CRZ contract to the supplier's legal identity and financials in one step — the fastest route to 'which bank/PSP holds which public contract and how much'. Documented unauthenticated public-API limit around 60 requests/minute/IP; weekly SQL dumps (Sundays from 04:00) with continuously updated API data; free first month, then a price list, with free access stated for research/charitable use.

source_name: Uvostat — register zmlúv view
why_relevant: Third-party analytics site best known for restructuring ÚVO procurement data, which also offers a CRZ contract view. Useful cross-link between the notice layer (A2 tender notices) and the signed-contract layer, e.g. to spot contracts with no matching notice.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — Zmluvy, objednávky, faktúry
why_relevant: NBS publishes its own contracts, orders and invoices on its site rather than (or in addition to) CRZ — sources indicate NBS holds the remaining statutory exception from CRZ publication since 31.3.2022, so its own pages are the only disclosure channel. Directly relevant for central-bank spend on cash processing, banknote handling, payment infrastructure, IT for payment systems and supervisory reporting systems.

source_name: Ministerstvo financií SR — Zverejňovanie zmlúv, objednávok a faktúr
why_relevant: The MF SR is the policy owner for state treasury, payments and public finance IT; its own invoice/order register shows recurring spend on banking, treasury and payment-system suppliers, and points onward to its subordinate bodies (Štátna pokladnica, DataCentrum, Finančná správa). MF SR also runs opendata.mfsr.sk for structured public-finance data.

source_name: Štátna pokladnica — CRZ entity page + pokladnica.sk terms and price lists
source_subtype: entity contract set + official terms and conditions
why_relevant: The State Treasury is the counterparty for account-keeping and payment services for the whole public sector: 'Zmluva o bežnom účte' instances, Všeobecné podmienky ŠP for account keeping and settlement of payment operations, and Osobitné podmienky pre poskytovanie platobnej brány ŠP (state payment gateway). Together the CRZ entity page and the pokladnica.sk document set reveal both the contractual template and who supplies the treasury's payment/gateway infrastructure — a core competitive-intelligence target for payments vendors.

source_name: Sociálna poisťovňa — Zmluvy, faktúry a objednávky
why_relevant: One of the largest SK payment originators (pensions and benefits) — its invoice and order register exposes recurring spend on bank transfers, postal money orders (poštové poukazy), cash disbursement and payment processing, plus the contract layer with its house bank and with Slovenská pošta. Invoice pages are deeply paginated and query-parameterised (supplier_name, supplier_id, order, page), which makes structured harvesting feasible.

source_name: Finančná správa SR — zmluvy, faktúry a objednávky
why_relevant: The tax and customs administration is a major payments-adjacent buyer: eKasa fiscal-cash-register infrastructure, card acceptance for tax/customs payments, cash collection and bank charges. Its contract, order and invoice pages (Daňové riaditeľstvo / Colné riaditeľstvo) name the vendors behind SK fiscal-device and payment-acceptance infrastructure.

source_name: Slovenská pošta, a.s. — contracts in CRZ / zmluvy.gov.sk and eGovZmluvy
why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is a key cash-handling and payments channel (poštové poukazy, cash-in at counters, historic bank partnership) and an obliged publisher. Its contract set exposes counter-payment, cash-logistics and terminal/IT suppliers that never surface in the tender-notice layer when awarded directly.

source_name: Hlavné mesto SR Bratislava — Zverejňovanie (zmluvy, objednávky, faktúry)
why_relevant: Largest SK municipality; runs its own full disclosure register in parallel with CRZ, publishing contracts, orders, invoices and decisions since 1.1.2011, with an entity-indexed view (e.g. a page for NBS as counterparty at /bratislava/subjekty/30844789/). Municipal registers reveal card-acceptance for parking/transport fares, cash collection and municipal account banking — a recurring payments-vendor market.

source_name: Ministerstvo hospodárstva SR — zmluvy / objednávky a faktúry
why_relevant: Representative example of the ministry-level objednávky/faktúry pattern (mirrored at economy.gov.sk). Ministry invoice registers are where bank charges, card-acceptance fees and payment-service line items appear as recurring low-value spend that never reaches a tender. Same page structure recurs across MPSVR, MŽP, SOI, ÚOOÚ, SSC and other bodies, so a single scraper template covers many entities.

source_name: Povinne zverejňované zmluvy v Obchodnom vestníku (Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR)
why_relevant: Complementary statutory disclosure channel: certain mandatorily-published contracts appear in the Commercial Bulletin rather than (or as well as) CRZ, and Obchodný vestník hosts downloadable contract PDFs — a Štátna pokladnica 'Zmluva o bežnom účte' PDF was found served from its SuborDownload endpoint. Covers entities and contract types that fall outside CRZ indexing.

source_name: Zákon č. 211/2000 Z. z. §5a + zákon č. 546/2010 Z. z. — publication duty and exemptions
why_relevant: Defines the boundary of this whole layer: which contracts must be published in full, which are published only as a summary notice of conclusion (§5a ods. 5 letters incl. c, d, i, j, r, s — the group that covers financial-instrument and payment-service-provision contracts), and which entity is exempt (sources state only NBS retains an exemption since 31.3.2022). Essential for calibrating coverage claims and for knowing when an absent contract means 'exempt' rather than 'no deal'.

source_name: CRZ-scraper / CRZ Explorer open-source tooling (GitHub)
why_relevant: Existing open-source code that downloads CRZ XML databases, builds a CSV contract database, filters, downloads attachments and extracts tables — plus a searchable datasette-lite build of CRZ contracts. Saves substantial engineering time and documents the real field structure of the CRZ XML export.

source_name: RZOF / zverejni.info / zverejnovanie.sk — smaller commercial disclosure platforms
why_relevant: A cluster of smaller SaaS providers (RZOF by EMEL Bratislava, zverejni.info, zverejnovanie.sk) hosting the zmluvy/objednávky/faktúry registers of hundreds of small obliged entities — schools, hospitals, budgetary organisations. Individually marginal, collectively they are where the long tail of card-terminal, cash-collection and bank-fee spend outside CRZ-indexed bodies is visible.

source_name: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka, a.s. — CRZ entity page
why_relevant: State-owned development bank that is itself an obliged publisher in CRZ. Its contract set reveals a bank's own procurement of core banking, card, IT and payment-processing services — an unusually direct window into a bank-side vendor relationship that in private banks is invisible.

source_name: Ministerstvo financií SR — Verejné obstarávanie / Profil verejného obstarávateľa
why_relevant: MF SR is the policy owner and buyer for state payment/treasury systems; its own procurement section carries the buyer profile pointer, contacts and links to plans before bulletin publication.

source_name: Ministerstvo financií SR — Plán verejného obstarávania
why_relevant: Annual procurement plan is the earliest formal signal of upcoming banking/payment-related contracts, typically months ahead of a notice.

source_name: Štátna pokladnica — Verejné obstarávanie
source_subtype: buyer procurement page with market consultations
why_relevant: Central state treasury; page confirmed to publish prípravné trhové konzultácie (preliminary market consultations), e.g. modernisation/extension of infrastructure for payment systems, with named contacts and NDA registration deadlines — the earliest possible demand signal.

source_name: Štátna pokladnica — profil na ÚVO (detail 8622)
why_relevant: Statutory buyer profile where the treasury must publish contracts, tender documents, references and summary reports.

source_name: ÚVO — Vyhľadávanie profilov (buyer profile directory)
why_relevant: Master index resolving every state buyer in this cell to its profile ID; the backbone for building a buyer-keyed watchlist.

source_name: Finančná správa SR — Profil verejného obstarávateľa
why_relevant: Tax/customs administration; buyer of ISFS-SD support and the eKasa ecosystem; page also lists prípravné trhové konzultácie. Points to ÚVO profile ID 12252.
